observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show stacks of used tires in a dusty, open storage area under a wooden roof.
Tires are piled vertically in multiple stacks, with some lying on the ground in the foreground.
The tires appear worn, with visible tread wear and dirt; some have visible damage or cracks.
The sidewalls of some tires are partially visible; one tire in the foreground of photo 1 shows partial text 'COOPER' and '235/60R18'.
The environment is unclean, with dirt and debris on the ground, suggesting outdoor or semi-outdoor storage.
No visible brand or model markings are clear on most tires; only partial text is legible on one tire.
The photos are nearly identical, with slight differences in lighting and shadow, suggesting they are duplicates or taken moments apart.

claims.evidence: The photos show multiple tires, but no size markings are clearly visible on most. Only one tire shows partial size '235/60R18' in photo 1, which is not enough to confirm 'all sizes'.

risks.risk: Tires may have hidden damage such as internal cracks, bulges, or dry rot not visible from the outside.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the sidewalls and treads of each tire, especially showing the inner walls and shoulder areas.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially unsafe or unusable, with lower value due to hidden defects.

risks.risk: Tires may be expired or have very low tread depth, reducing their usability and safety.
risks.proof: Close-up photos showing tread depth and wear indicators, ideally with a tread depth gauge for reference.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as low-quality or near-end-of-life, with reduced value.

risks.risk: Tires may be mismatched or not suitable for specific vehicle types, affecting resale or usability.
risks.proof: Clear photos of sidewall markings (size, load index, speed rating) for each tire.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic used tires without specific application, reducing value.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the sidewalls of at least 5 different tires showing brand, size, load index, and speed rating.
Close-up photos of tread depth and condition, including any cracks or bulges.
Photos of the inner walls of the tires to check for internal damage.
response.reason: The photos show used tires, but critical details like brand, size, and condition are not clearly visible. Without proof of specific sizes, tread depth, and structural integrity, a reliable price cannot be determined. The claim of 'all sizes' is unverified, and hidden risks like damage or expiration affect value.
